input.rationale: Section 12(b) gives a TrueLink indemnity, but it is limited to claims arising from TrueLink's breach of the Agreement or failure to perform its obligations. The Agreement contains no TrueLink non-infringement warranty (searches for "infring"/"warrants" return only Client-side representations in Sections 2(h) and 8(e)), so no third-party IP infringement claim against us relating to TrueLink's Interface, Hosting or Support Services is covered — nor are TrueLink's breaches of law, TrueLink-caused unauthorized disclosure of Client Content, or its gross negligence/willful misconduct. That fails both the preferred position and the fallback (which at minimum requires a Vendor IP indemnity). By contrast, the Client indemnity in Section 12(a) is very broad, including Web Site/Client Content claims "without regard to any knowledge limitation" and product/service injury claims. We propose the minimal fix of adding a new Section 12(c) Vendor indemnity mirroring the playbook's model language; we have not attempted to narrow our own Section 12(a) indemnity in this redline, which remains a residual point we would note in negotiation.

ops.text: c. In addition, TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents from and against all claims, actions, expenses, losses and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to any third-party claim to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any other materials or services provided by TrueLink infringe or misappropriate any copyright, patent, trade secret, trademark or other intellectual property right; (ii) TrueLink's violation of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Client Confidential Information caused by TrueLink; or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a TrueLink indemnity for third-party intellectual property claims, its breach of law, TrueLink-caused data breaches and its gross negligence or willful misconduct, since the current Section 12(b) covers only breach of the Agreement and leaves us exposed on infringement claims relating to TrueLink's own Interface and services. If helpful, we can accept an IP-only indemnity with the usual exclusions (our modifications, combinations and specifications) and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.
proposal.summary: Add TrueLink indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and willful misconduct.
